props.title: Life Skills & Personal Development Programme Batch 11

props.editor: The seminar is intended to introduce participants to key perspectives of the ‘Personal Development & Life Skills to enable them perform better at the work place and beyond'.

icon_list.text: By the end of this seminar, participants should be able to:
Understand some basic principles of Personal Development required to improve their work schedule.
Identify the knowledge and practical skills effective Life Skills required for improving their job roles.
